title: ONTO-TIME Original Direct Risk & Cue Stage experiments

scientific_targets.target: Separate direct lethal size predation window from separately randomized early and late nonlethal exposure effects on tadpole period and risk behavior
scientific_targets.independent_unit: individual in predation trial or 2-stage tank ID in behavior and life history
scientific_targets.risk_note: Cannot pool individual ID with tank ID or invent repeated measures

scientific_targets.target: Predator-stage cue recognition transfer across larval/adult beetle versus salamander, with clutch and conditioning pail clustering
scientific_targets.independent_unit: conditioning pail within clutch, individual tadpole test nested
scientific_targets.risk_note: 36? 18 conditioning pails per experiment, 6 clutches; do not count ~360 tadpoles as independent conditioning units

scientific_targets.target: Independent size-structure predator control on tadpole community fate across mesocosms and dates; not reverse predation
scientific_targets.risk_note: Dependent repeated bouts and treatment replication

run_method: GitHub Actions ephemeral public source fetch then sanitized schema/sha receipt; never upload raw third party files

reporting.source_schema: file sha256, mime/bytes, columns, nrows/sheets, treatment labels only (no outcomes)
reporting.if_unavailable: SOURCE_BLOCKED explicit; no synthetic substitutions, no values

model_gates.size_predation: prespecified binary survival ~ standardized tadpole SVL + backswimmer TL + trial; cluster by individual/assignment where possible; source context-dependent
model_gates.late_nonconsumptive: tank-level paired factorial stage1 x stage2 randomized treatments; outcomes larval.period plus step2 behavior separate; report group means, equal-tank estimator and factorial contrast if valid
model_gates.cue_stage: post minus pre movement in 3 conditioning × 2 test stage, grouped and cluster-aware by pail/clutch; compare beetle vs salamander only after source schema gate
model_gates.salamander_size: mesocosm-level treatment at repeated bouts; negative/nonreciprocal control only

original_source_publication_clarity: The original papers already report directional effects; exploratory reanalysis is not independent discovery, even if raw-data numerical methods are new.
